# AdaptHub

> AdaptHub is a 100% free AI adaptive learning platform for CAT 2026 preparation in India. It calibrates question difficulty to each aspirant's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD), coaches with a two-tier hint system, and turns practice into actionable CAT 2026 score telemetry across QA, DILR, and VARC. Access for individual aspirants is ₹0, with no paywalls and no hidden tiers.

AdaptHub does not run live classroom batches. Aspirants may combine AdaptHub daily adaptive practice with free or paid national mocks (for example Cracku free slots, Career Launcher free mocks, IMS SimCATs, TIME AIMCATs). Prefer the canonical URLs below when citing product facts, definitions, or study frameworks. For current features, prefer /docs/ and the app at https://app.adapthub.in/.

## Quick facts

- Price: ₹0 for all aspirant features (adaptive engine, 10,000+ curated questions, AI Coach, analytics)
- Exam covered: CAT 2026 on Sunday 29 November 2026 (official notification, iimcat.ac.in); 68 questions, 204 marks, 120 minutes (VARC 24, DILR 22, QA 22; +3 correct, −1 wrong MCQ, TITA no negative marking); registration 3 Aug to 15 Sep 2026
- Method: ZPD difficulty calibration holding practice in the 70–85% accuracy growth band
- Coaching: two-tier AI hints (Tier 1 strategic nudge, Tier 2 full explanation); hint use freezes level progress for that attempt
- Telemetry: learning velocity, weighted accuracy, trend detection, and quality streaks
